edits.old: Then the operation answers status 404 and no partner session resolves
edits.new:
Then the operation answers status 404 and no partner session resolves

  Scenario: AC20 A replay of a write with the same Idempotency-Key answers the first answer (§12.1 operation)
    Given "P-5101" made a resolution with an Idempotency-Key and the first answer was served
    When the gateway replays the same resolution with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the call answers the first answer and writes no second decision record

  Scenario: AC21 A consumed call that fails or does not answer gets no role
    Given the call the resolution consumes for "P-5101" fails or does not answer
    When the gateway calls the resolution for "P-5101"
    Then the call returns status 503 with message Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P4-E2019-APP-AC18) and no role is answered
